notes: Fixed every fresh install silently capturing into one specific account's workspace instead of your own: the extension used to ship with that account's API key baked in as a fallback default, so anyone who installed it without pasting their own key was actually using someone else's workspace without knowing it. There is no shared default anymore — existing installs still on the old baked-in key are automatically reset to "not connected" on this update. Ask your admin for your own API key and license key (Settings → API Keys / License Keys) and paste them into Options to reconnect to your own workspace.
